text: AI Memory Brain is designed as a model and agent framework independent memory authority. Memory should remain portable traceable and governable across agents models and runtimes.

Canonical Memory is what the system knows and why. Memory Context is what a particular agent task needs now. Applied Context is what the adapter attests to applying. Sending a context package does not prove an agent applied it.

Scope-before-Candidate is a hard invariant. Unauthorized records must not become candidates for fusion reranking counting or activation. Bind trusted scope and permission predicates inside each backend before candidate output. Never run global ANN top K then post-filter.

Query routing maps exact identifiers and structured predicates to structured fields, rare quoted terms to full text, paraphrase to ANN, typed relation paths to graph, temporal expressions to temporal index, and why source or proof questions to provenance and evidence.

Canonical Store is authoritative and index is a rebuildable projection. Stale or orphan index hits must be suppressed. Revalidate canonical lifecycle scope permission and forget state before ranking and final return.

Memory lifecycle includes Candidate Consolidated Active Superseded Archived and Forgotten. Forget Fence must suppress ordinary reads and activation before asynchronous cleanup. Archived is not Forgotten and forgotten identity cannot be restored.

Evidence records source reference version locator digest collector time scope and evidential role. Provenance records derivation method version input digests and parent lineage. Provenance provides traceability but does not prove source authenticity or truth.

Applied requires adapter evidence bound to ContextVersion ChangeSet adapter identity inference request or final request digest scope and permission epoch. Delivered acknowledgement is not proof of Applied. Applied does not prove the model understood or followed memory.
Forget Fence and stale cache context snapshot delta delivery must suppress this forgotten memory from recall and activation.
